name: rust-json-vertical-slice
description: Classifies JSON vertical-slice divergences between the Rust candidate, shared fixtures, and the Ruby golden master.

divergences.observation: The first Rust renderer appended all template-only owners after destination owners.
divergences.golden_master_behavior: Leading template-only owners are inserted before the next shared owner; trailing template-only owners follow retained destination-only owners.

divergences.observation: The shared fixture expected canonical minified JSON.
divergences.golden_master_behavior: The multiline destination layout is retained while the missing nested owner is synthesized.

divergences.observation: The shared fixture expected a destination-only parser fallback that removed trailing commas.
divergences.golden_master_behavior: Strict JSON fails closed with a destination parse error and no output.

divergences.observation: The shared feature profile advertised the removed trailing-comma fallback policy.
divergences.golden_master_behavior: The JSON family advertises JSON, JSONC, and JSON5 plus destination-wins array behavior, with no parser fallback policy.

divergences.observation: The shared Tree-sitter adapter fixture marked JSONC unsupported.
divergences.golden_master_behavior: JSONC parses through TreeHaver's JSON5 grammar with JSONC subset validation.
